name: 9795-imageprefill-internvl3-1b-1gpu
model: OpenGVLab/InternVL3-1B. ~2 GB of safetensors, public and ungated.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, one node, no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 600 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` + `synthetic_image`, one turn: one 3072x2304 image and a 32-token text prompt in, 32 tokens out, all three lengths fixed with `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A compact vision assistant captioning single high-resolution photos with short prompts and replies, 16 concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# sglang at commit bcf1955f7e423184894ed415a7eca8f0239cea21 (`git describe` = v0.5.2rc2-120-gbcf1955f7e4).
# host / port / served-model-name are owned by whatever starts the server and are not written here.

model-path: OpenGVLab/InternVL3-1B
tp-size: 1
trust-remote-code: true
attention-backend: fa3
mm-attention-backend: fa3
chunked-prefill-size: 4096

# 0.7, not the usual 0.9: at 0.9 an 80 GB card has almost nothing outside the KV pool.
mem-fraction-static: 0.7
